info.name: NYC Historical Vital Records (NYC Open Data)
info.description:
Postman collection for the **NYC Historical Vital Records** indexes published by the NYC Department of Records and Information Services (DORIS) / Municipal Archives on NYC Open Data (Socrata SODA API):

| Dataset | ID | Years | Rows |
|---|---|---|---|
| Births | 5gq7-rgmv | 1855–1909 | ~2.6M |
| Deaths | 797j-9xvg | 1862–1948 | ~3.7M |
| Marriages | j62e-7maa | 1866–1937 | ~5.3M |
| Marriage licenses | d8dr-nyhw | 1908–1949 | ~1.3M |

No key required. An optional Socrata app token (`app_token`, sent as `X-App-Token`) raises rate limits.

**Set variables:** `last_name`, `first_name` (prefix, optional), `borough` (MANHATTAN, KINGS, BRONX, QUEENS, RICHMOND or blank), `year_from`, `year_to`, `limit`.

Every search shows a table in the **Visualize** tab with a *view* link that opens the certificate on https://a860-historicalvitalrecords.nyc.gov.
